title: Multimodal X-* chunker markers (7 formats)
wanted_capability: Chunker markers for the 7 deferred multimodal formats: X-PDF, X-IPYNB, X-XLSX, X-DOCX-PPTX, X-HTML, X-AV, X-IMG. Embedding model selection (per design/multimodal-embedding-routing.md) is the X-IMG blocker.
notes: X-PDF (highest user priority per design A3), X-IPYNB, X-XLSX, X-DOCX-PPTX, X-HTML, X-AV (audio/video transcripts), X-IMG (standalone images, blocked on multimodal embed model selection per design §20.3). Embedding routing design now exists.
